note: Chemokine-receptor-based Th polarization on non-Tfh memory CD4 (CXCR3 × CCR6). Th1: Type-1 helper T cells (IFNγ producers; this gate also absorbs the plastic Th1/17 'Th1*' subset) — right region (CXCR3+, any CCR6). Th17_22: IL-17 / IL-22 producing Th cells — upper-left quadrant (CXCR3-, CCR6+). non_17_22_1: Th2 candidates and uncommitted effectors — lower-left quadrant (both CXCR3- and CCR6-).
tips: Chemokine-receptor-based Th polarization on non-Tfh memory CD4. Th1: CXCR3+ (any CCR6) — by this definition Th1 also absorbs the plastic Th1/17 subset (CXCR3+CCR6+, IFNγ+IL-17+). Th17_22: CXCR3- CCR6+. non_17_22_1: CXCR3- CCR6-. Design caveat: CXCR3+ Th1 absorbs CXCR3+CCR6+ (Th1*) events, inflating Th1 frequency vs strict CXCR3+CCR6- Th1. The downstream Th1 activation-state analysis (Step 9) is performed on this mixed Th1 compartment. To isolate Th1/17, add a CXCR3+CCR6+ label here (4-way split). No Th-lineage TFs in panel (T-bet / RORγt / GATA3 absent), so chemokine-receptor geometry carries the call.
